        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    const stream = new ReadableStream({\n      async start(controller) {\n        if (!resp.body) return controller.close()\n        const reader = resp.body.getReader()\n        \n        try {\n          while (true) {\n            const { done, value } = await reader.read()\n            if (done) break\n            \n            const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })\n            // 简单透传 chunk，客户端负责解析 SSE 格式\n            controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(chunk))\n            buffer += chunk\n          }\n          appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, request_id: reqId, type: \"assistant_reply\", route: \"/api/deepseek\", model, status: \"ok\", duration_ms: Date.now() - t0, stream: true })\n        } catch (e) {\n          controller.error(e)\n        } finally {\n          controller.close()\n        }\n      }\n    })\n\n    return new NextResponse(stream, {\n      headers: {\n        \"Content-Type\": \"text/event-stream\",\n        \"Cache-Control\": \"no-cache\",\n        \"Connection\": \"keep-alive\",\n      }\n    })\n  }\n\n  const bff = getBffUrl()\n  let resp2: Response\n  try {\n    resp2 = await fetch(&#96;${bff}/deepseek/chat&#96;, {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n      body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages, temperature: body?.temperature ?? 0 })\n    })\n  } catch (e: any) {\n    appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, request_id: reqId, type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/deepseek\", model, status: \"error\", error: e?.message ?? String(e), duration_ms: Date.now() - t0 })\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: \"network_error\", detail: e?.message ?? String(e) }, { status: 502 })\n  }\n  if (!resp2.ok) {\n    const err = await resp2.text().catch(() =&gt; \"\")\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  const body = await req.json().catch(() =&gt; ({})) as any\n  const query = String(body?.query ?? \"\").trim()\n  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(body?.limit ?? 5)))\n  const temperature = Number(body?.temperature ?? 0)\n  if (!query) return NextResponse.json({ error: \"missing_query\" }, { status: 400 })\n  const sessionId = getSessionIdFromHeaders(req.headers) || crypto.randomUUID()\n  const reqId = crypto.randomUUID()\n  const t0 = Date.now()\n  appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, request_id: reqId, type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/rag/answer\", status: \"started\", meta: { query_len: query.length, limit } })\n\n  const items = await searchHtml(query, limit)\n  const evidence = items.map((it, i) =&gt; &#96;[${i + 1}] ${it.title}\\n${it.snippet}\\n${it.url}&#96;).join(\"\\n\\n\")\n  const sys = [\n    \"你是检索增强回答助手。\",\n    \"根据提供的检索片段回答用户问题，用简洁的中文要点形式作答。\",\n    \"在引用处以 [编号] 标注来源，编号对应提供的片段列表。\",\n    \"若信息不足，直接说明需要更多信息，不要编造。\"\n  ].join(\"\\n\")\n  const user = [\n    &#96;问题：${query}&#96;,\n    \"检索片段：\",\n    evidence || \"(无片段)\"\n  ].join(\"\\n\\n\")\n\n  const bff = getBffUrl()\n  let resp: Response\n  try {\n    resp = await fetch(&#96;${bff}/deepseek/chat&#96;, {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n      body: JSON.stringify({ model: \"deepseek-chat\", messages: [{ role: \"system\", content: sys }, { role: \"user\", content: user }], temperature })\n    })\n  } catch (e: any) {\n    appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, request_id: reqId, type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/rag/answer\", status: \"error\", error: e?.message ?? String(e), duration_ms: Date.now() - t0 })\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: \"network_error\", detail: e?.message ?? String(e) }, { status: 502 })\n  }\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.text().catch(() =&gt; \"\")\n}",

        "contents": "import crypto from \"node:crypto\"\nimport { appendLog, getSessionIdFromHeaders } from \"../../../lib/logger\"\n\n/**\n * POST /api/tools/search\n * 接收 JSON 请求体 { query: string, limit?: number }\n * 依次尝试 Bing → 360 → 百度 抓取搜索结果\n * 返回 { query, items: Array&lt;{title,url,snippet}&gt; }\n */\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // 解析请求体，容错空对象\n  const body = await req.json().catch(() =&gt; ({})) as any\n  // 提取并清洗查询词\n  const query = String(body?.query ?? \"\").trim()\n  // 限制 limit 在 1~10 之间，默认 5\n  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(body?.limit ?? 5)))\n  // 查询词为空直接返回 400\n  if (!query) return NextResponse.json({ error: \"missing_query\" }, { status: 400 })\n\n  // 从请求头获取 sessionId，若无则生成\n  const sessionId = getSessionIdFromHeaders(req.headers) || crypto.randomUUID()\n  // 记录开始日志\n  appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"tool_run\", route: \"/api/tools/search\", status: \"started\", meta: { query_len: query.length, limit } })\n\n  /**\n   * 按指定搜索引擎抓取 HTML 结果\n   * @param source 搜索引擎：bing | so | baidu\n   * @returns 搜索结果数组，失败返回空数组\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export async function registerDeepseekChat(fastify: FastifyInstance) {\n  fastify.route({\n    method: 'GET',\n    url: '/deepseek/key_check',\n    handler: async (_request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) =&gt; {\n      const hasKey = !!getDeepseekKey()\n      return reply.send({ hasKey })\n    }\n  })\n  fastify.route({\n    method: 'POST',\n    url: '/deepseek/chat',\n    handler: async (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) =&gt; {\n      const apiKey = getDeepseekKey()\n      if (!apiKey) return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY missing' })\n      const body = (request.body ?? {}) as any\n      const messages: ChatMessage[] = Array.isArray(body?.messages) ? body.messages : [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }]\n      const model = String(body?.model ?? 'deepseek-chat')\n      const temperature = Number.isFinite(Number(body?.temperature)) ? Number(body.temperature) : 0\n      const resp = await fetch('https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${apiKey}&#96; },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages, temperature })\n      })\n      if (!resp.ok) {\n        const txt = await resp.text().catch(() =&gt; '')\n        return reply.status(502).send({ error: 'upstream_error', detail: txt })\n      }\n      type DeepseekResponse = { choices?: Array&lt;{ message?: { content?: string } }&gt; }\n      const data = (await resp.json()) as DeepseekResponse\n      const content = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ?? ''\n      return reply.send({ model, content })\n    }\n  })\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 注册 Deepseek SSE 路由：将上游片段转为标准 SSE 的 data: 行\n */\nexport async function registerDeepseekSSE(fastify: FastifyInstance) {\n  fastify.route({\n    method: 'GET',\n    url: '/deepseek/sse',\n    handler: async (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) =&gt; {\n      const apiKey = getDeepseekKey()\n      if (!apiKey) {\n        headers(reply)\n        reply.raw.write(&#96;event: error\\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ message: 'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY missing' })}\\n\\n&#96;)\n        reply.raw.end()\n        return\n      }\n      headers(reply)\n      const q = String((request.query as any)?.q ?? '').trim()\n      const messages: ChatMessage[] = q ? [{ role: 'user', content: q }] : [{ role: 'user', content: '' }]\n      try {\n        const resp = await upstream(messages, apiKey)\n        const reader = resp.body?.getReader()\n        if (!reader) {\n          reply.raw.write(&#96;event: error\\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ message: 'no_stream' })}\\n\\n&#96;)\n          reply.raw.end()\n          return\n        }\n        const encoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8')\n        let closed = false\n        request.raw.on('close', () =&gt; { closed = true })\n        while (!closed) {\n          const { value, done } = await reader.read()\n          if (done) break\n          const text = encoder.decode(value)\n          const lines = text.split(/\\r?\\n/)\n          for (const line of lines) {\n            const chunk = extractContent(line)\n            if (chunk) reply.raw.write(&#96;data: ${JSON.stringify(chunk)}\\n\\n&#96;)\n          }\n        }\n        reply.raw.end()\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        reply.raw.write(&#96;event: error\\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ message: e?.message ?? String(e) })}\\n\\n&#96;)\n        reply.raw.end()\n      }\n    }\n  })\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * POST /api/kb/search\n * - 语义检索知识库，返回 Top‑k 片段\n */\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\"\nimport crypto from \"node:crypto\"\nimport { appendLog, getSessionIdFromHeaders } from \"../../../lib/logger\"\nimport * as kb from \"@aiagent/retrieval\"\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  const body = await req.json().catch(() =&gt; ({})) as any\n  const query = String(body?.query ?? \"\").trim()\n  const k = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(body?.k ?? 5)))\n  if (!query) return NextResponse.json({ error: \"missing_query\" }, { status: 400 })\n  const sessionId = getSessionIdFromHeaders(req.headers) || crypto.randomUUID()\n  appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/kb/search\", status: \"started\", meta: { query_len: query.length, k } })\n  const res = kb.search({ query, k })\n  appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"assistant_reply\", route: \"/api/kb/search\", status: \"ok\", meta: { items_count: res.items?.length ?? 0 } })\n  return NextResponse.json(res)\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * DeepSeek 安全代理路由\n *\n * 目的：仅在服务端读取 &#96;DEEPSEEK_API_KEY&#96;，将前端请求安全转发到 DeepSeek Chat Completions，避免在浏览器暴露密钥。\n *\n * 路径与方法：\n * - GET /api/deepseek    返回密钥是否存在：{ hasKey: boolean }\n * - POST /api/deepseek   代理对话请求，支持流式传输\n *\n * 环境变量：\n * - DEEPSEEK_API_KEY     DeepSeek 平台的 API Key，仅服务器端读取\n *\n * 请求体（POST）：\n * {\n *   model?: string                // 默认 \"deepseek-chat\"\n *   messages: Array&lt;{ role: \"user\"|\"system\"|\"assistant\", content: string }&gt;\n *   temperature?: number          // 默认 0\n *   stream?: boolean              // 是否开启流式传输，默认 false\n * }\n *\n * 错误语义：\n * - 400 { error: \"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY missing\" }         // 未配置密钥\n * - 502 { error: \"upstream_error\", detail: string }   // 上游 DeepSeek 返回错误\n *\n * 安全说明：\n * - 切勿在客户端代码中读取或下发 &#96;DEEPSEEK_API_KEY&#96;；该路由仅在服务器端访问环境变量。\n */\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\"\nimport { getBffUrl } from \"../../lib/env\"\nimport crypto from \"node:crypto\"\nimport { appendLog, writeSessionSnapshot, getSessionIdFromHeaders } from \"../../lib/logger\"\n\nconst DEEPSEEK_API_URL = \"https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions\"\n\n/**\n * 健康检查：返回是否已配置密钥\n */\nexport async function GET() {\n  const bff = getBffUrl()\n  try {\n    const resp = await fetch(&#96;${bff}/deepseek/key_check&#96;)\n    const data = await resp.json().catch(() =&gt; ({ hasKey: false }))\n    appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/deepseek\", method: \"GET\", status: \"ok\" })\n    return NextResponse.json({ hasKey: !!data?.hasKey })\n  } catch {\n    appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/deepseek\", method: \"GET\", status: \"error\" })\n    return NextResponse.json({ hasKey: false }, { status: 200 })\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 对话代理：将请求体转发至 DeepSeek Chat Completions\n */\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  const body = await req.json().catch(() =&gt; ({})) as any\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * POST /api/kb/add_text\n * - 将纯文本切分入库，生成向量并持久化到索引\n * GET /api/kb/add_text\n * - 返回当前索引统计信息\n */\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\"\nimport * as kb from \"@aiagent/retrieval\"\nimport crypto from \"node:crypto\"\nimport { appendLog, getSessionIdFromHeaders, writeSessionSnapshot } from \"../../../lib/logger\"\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  const body = await req.json().catch(() =&gt; ({})) as any\n  const title = String(body?.title ?? \"\")\n  const text = String(body?.text ?? \"\")\n  if (!text || text.length &lt; 10) return NextResponse.json({ error: \"text_too_short\" }, { status: 400 })\n  if (text.length &gt; 200_000) return NextResponse.json({ error: \"text_too_long\" }, { status: 400 })\n  const sessionId = getSessionIdFromHeaders(req.headers) || crypto.randomUUID()\n  appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/kb/add_text\", status: \"started\", meta: { title_len: title.length, text_len: text.length } })\n  const out = kb.addDocument({ title, text })\n  const st = kb.stats()\n  writeSessionSnapshot(sessionId, { last_updated_at: new Date().toISOString(), last_added: { docId: out.docId, added: out.added } })\n  appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"assistant_reply\", route: \"/api/kb/add_text\", status: \"ok\", meta: { added: out.added } })\n  return NextResponse.json({ added: out.added, docId: out.docId, stats: st })\n}\n\nexport async function GET() {\n  return NextResponse.json(kb.stats())\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  const t0 = Date.now()\n  const body = await req.json().catch(() =&gt; ({})) as any\n  const prompt = String(body?.prompt ?? \"\").trim()\n  if (!prompt) return NextResponse.json({ error: \"missing_prompt\" }, { status: 400 })\n  const sessionId = getSessionIdFromHeaders(req.headers) || crypto.randomUUID()\n  const requestId = crypto.randomUUID()\n\n  appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, request_id: requestId, type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/agent/plan_execute\", status: \"started\", meta: { prompt_len: prompt.length } })\n\n  const tools = builtinTools()\n  const trace: TraceStep[] = []\n  const used_tools: Array&lt;{ tool: string; args: Record&lt;string, any&gt;; duration_ms: number }&gt; = []\n  let context = \"\"\n  let kb_hit = false\n  let top_score = 0\n\n  // Step 1: KB 检索\n  {\n    const s0 = Date.now()\n    const res = kb.search({ query: prompt, k: 5 })\n    const d = Date.now() - s0\n    trace.push({ step: \"kb_search\", detail: { items: res.items?.length ?? 0 }, duration_ms: d })\n    used_tools.push({ tool: \"kb_search\", args: { query: prompt, k: 5 }, duration_ms: d })\n    if (res.items &amp;&amp; res.items.length &gt; 0) {\n      kb_hit = true\n      top_score = Number(res.items[0]?.score ?? 0)\n      if (top_score &gt;= 0.6) {\n        context = res.items.map(it =&gt; &#96;【${it.title || it.docId}】\\n${it.text}&#96;).join(\"\\n\\n\")\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Step 2: 搜索与抓取（若 KB 未命中或分数较低）\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nasync function tryHtml(source: \"bing\" | \"so\" | \"baidu\") {\n/gi\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const resp = await fetch(url, UA)\n      if (!resp.ok) return [] as Array&lt;{ title: string; url: string; snippet: string }&gt;\n\n      const html = await resp.text()\n      const items: Array&lt;{ title: string; url: string; snippet: string }&gt; = []\n      let m: RegExpExecArray | null\n      // 循环提取结果，最多 limit 条\n      while ((m = pattern.exec(html)) &amp;&amp; items.length &lt; limit) {\n        const href = m[1]\n        // 去除标签保留纯文本\n        const title = String(m[2]).replace(/&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;/g, \" \").trim()\n        const snippet = String(m[3]).replace(/&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;/g, \" \").trim()\n        items.push({ title, url: href, snippet })\n      }\n      return items\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      // 抓取失败记录错误日志\n      appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"tool_run\", route: \"/api/tools/search\", status: \"error\", error: e?.message ?? String(e) })\n      return []\n    }\n  }\n\n  try {\n    // 优先 Bing，失败则降级 360，再失败则百度\n    let items = await tryHtml(\"bing\")\n    if (items.length === 0) items = await tryHtml(\"so\")\n    if (items.length === 0) items = await tryHtml(\"baidu\")\n\n    // 记录成功日志\n    appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"tool_run\", route: \"/api/tools/search\", status: \"ok\", meta: { items_count: items.length } })\n    return NextResponse.json({ query, items })\n  } catch (e: any) {\n    // 兜底异常记录\n    appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"tool_run\", route: \"/api/tools/search\", status: \"error\", error: e?.message ?? String(e) })\n    return NextResponse.json({ query, items: [] })\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * POST /api/rag/kb_answer\n * - 以知识库片段作为检索证据，调用 DeepSeek 生成带引用的回答\n * - 需要服务端环境变量 &#96;DEEPSEEK_API_KEY&#96;\n */\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\"\nimport * as kb from \"@aiagent/retrieval\"\nimport crypto from \"node:crypto\"\nimport { appendLog, getSessionIdFromHeaders } from \"../../../lib/logger\"\nimport { getBffUrl } from \"../../../lib/env\"\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  const body = await req.json().catch(() =&gt; ({})) as any\n  const query = String(body?.query ?? \"\").trim()\n  const k = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(body?.k ?? 5)))\n  const temperature = Number(body?.temperature ?? 0)\n  if (!query) return NextResponse.json({ error: \"missing_query\" }, { status: 400 })\n  const sessionId = getSessionIdFromHeaders(req.headers) || crypto.randomUUID()\n  const reqId = crypto.randomUUID()\n  const t0 = Date.now()\n  appendLog({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"web\", session_id: sessionId, request_id: reqId, type: \"api_call\", route: \"/api/rag/kb_answer\", status: \"started\", meta: { query_len: query.length, k } })\n\n  const res = kb.search({ query, k })\n  const items = res.items\n  const evidence = items.map((it, i) =&gt; &#96;[${i + 1}] ${it.title || \"(无标题)\"}\\n${it.text}&#96;).join(\"\\n\\n\")\n  const sys = [\n    \"你是知识库检索增强助手。\",\n    \"基于提供的知识库片段回答用户问题，用简洁要点作答。\",\n    \"在引用处以 [编号] 标注来源，编号对应提供的片段列表。\",\n    \"若信息不足，直接说明需要更多信息，不要编造。\"\n  ].join(\"\\n\")\n  const user = [&#96;问题：${query}&#96;, \"片段：\", evidence || \"(无片段)\"].join(\"\\n\\n\")\n\n  const bff = getBffUrl()\n  let resp: Response\n  try {\n    resp = await fetch(&#96;${bff}/deepseek/chat&#96;,\n\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 主函数：启动 CLI 聊天循环\n */\nasync function main() {\n  // 创建 readline 接口，用于读取用户输入\n  const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout })\n  // 存储聊天历史\n  const messages: ChatMessage[] = []\n  const tools = builtinTools()\n  const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID()\n  ensureSessionLog(sessionId)\n  console.log(\"AI Agent CLI. 输入内容后回车，输入 /exit 退出。\")\n  // 定义递归函数，持续询问用户输入\n  const ask = () =&gt; {\n    if ((rl as any).closed) return\n    rl.question(\"&gt; \", async (line: string) =&gt; {\n    // 如果用户输入 /exit，关闭接口并退出\n    if (line.trim() === \"/exit\") { rl.close(); return }\n    if (line.startsWith(\"/tool \")) {\n      try {\n        const json = line.slice(6)\n        const call = parseToolCall(json)\n        if (!call) throw new Error(\"invalid_tool_call\")\n        const t0 = Date.now()\n        logAppend(sessionId, { ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"cli\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"tool_run\", tool: call.tool, status: \"started\" })\n        const out = await executeTool(tools, call)\n        console.log(JSON.stringify(out, null, 2))\n        logAppend(sessionId, { ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"cli\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"tool_run\", tool: call.tool, status: \"ok\", duration_ms: Date.now() - t0 })\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        console.error(e?.message ?? String(e))\n        logAppend(sessionId, { ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"cli\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"tool_run\", status: \"error\", error: e?.message ?? String(e) })\n      }\n      if (!(rl as any).closed) ask()\n      return\n    }\n    // 将用户消息加入历史\n    messages.push({ role: \"user\", content: line })\n    logAppend(sessionId, { ts: new Date().toISOString(), app: \"cli\", session_id: sessionId, type: \"user_input\", content_excerpt: line.slice(0, 200) })\n    try {\n      const sys = toolSystemPrompt(tools)\n      const t0 = Date.now()\n  }\n\n}",

已完成项目分析，并创建了优化建议文档。主要发现如下：

## 主要优化点总结

### 1. 代码质量
- 前端页面组件过大（279 行），需要拆分
- 类型安全不足，大量使用 `any`
- 代码重复：搜索逻辑在多处重复实现

### 2. 安全性
- CORS 配置过于宽松（允许所有来源）
- 缺少 API 限流机制
- 环境变量验证不足
- 存在硬编码 URL

### 3. 性能
- 并发请求过多（同时发起 5 个请求）
- 缺少请求取消和去重机制
- 流式响应处理可优化

### 4. 错误处理
- 缺少统一的错误处理机制
- 前端缺少错误边界
- 错误信息格式不统一

### 5. 测试与文档
- 测试覆盖率低（约 10%）
- 缺少 API 文档
- 开发文档可完善

### 6. 部署与监控
- 缺少生产环境配置
- 缺少应用监控
- CI/CD
